prompt.project_info: Create a modern luxury lifestyle portrait of an approved adult platinum-blonde woman reclining on a cream curved sofa.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long platinum-blonde wavy hair, light blue eyes, fair natural skin, natural pink lips, minimal makeup, and a soft thoughtful expression. She wears a red fitted one-piece fashion outfit with thin straps, reclines on her side propped on one elbow, rests one hand under her chin and the other on the sofa, and looks toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 medium lifestyle frame, subject reclining diagonally on a cream white curved sofa, dark olive curtains and large wooden-framed window behind, white walls and contemporary apartment details.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural daylight from the window, gentle shadows, bright modern interior, relaxed sophisticated calm mood, natural neutral grading with rich red outfit.
prompt.technical_specs: Professional or high-end smartphone camera, eye-level front-facing perspective, medium framing with sofa visible, realistic skin and fabric, natural depth, subtle grain, 3:4 crop.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic modern luxury lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman with long platinum-blonde wavy hair, light blue eyes, fair natural skin, natural pink lips, minimal makeup, and a soft thoughtful expression. She wears a red fitted one-piece fashion outfit with thin straps and reclines on her side on a cream curved contemporary sofa, propped on one elbow, one hand under her chin and the other resting on the sofa, looking toward the camera. Include dark olive curtains, a large wooden-framed window, white walls, and a sophisticated minimalist apartment. Use soft diffused daylight, gentle shadows, eye-level perspective, realistic texture, natural depth, rich red and neutral tones, and a vertical 3:4 composition.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
